note: Ps74 communal lament over ruined sanctuary (corrected; God-act + destruction heavy). Human IB (thin, like a national lament): the enemies' blasphemy - their heart-resolve (leb) to SUBDUE, their SCOFF (charaph)/REVILE (naats)/FOOLISH (nabal) contempt of God's name; the afflicted community - the DOWNTRODDEN + POOR who plead to PRAISE God's name; the anguished 'none KNOWS how long'. God-qualifiers ~17 (cast-off/anger/remember x3/redeemed/direct/salvation/might/broke/defend/forget x2/name x4). Destruction-imagery (roared/burned/hatchets) + creation-recital (sea-monsters/Leviathan/seasons) + covenant = standalone. Every candidate roled.
